items.title: CFTC Staff Clarifies Crypto Use in Operating Reserves
items.summary: Staff guidance points to valuation discounts of at least 20% for bitcoin and ether and 2% for qualifying payment stablecoins.

items.title: Vstock Selects Metagood to Power Issuer-Sponsored Tokenization for Its 1,000+ Issuers
items.summary: SEC-registered transfer agent Vstock Transfer has selected Metagood’s platform to offer issuer-sponsored tokenized shares to its more than 1,000 issuers, with token and book-entry holders on one register.
